t: To carry out, except as otherwise provided for, sections 301 and 311 of the Act with respect to environmental health activities, $17,289,000.

fable.w: This is a bare appropriation of funds for environmental health activities under existing statutory sections. The tempting reading is that the referenced sections 301 and 311 might involve cooperation with states or outside entities, but the section itself sets out no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue. No party outside the federal government is brought into any federal decision here.
fable.s: To carry out, except as otherwise provided for, sections 301 and 311 of the Act with respect to environmental health activities, $17,289,000.

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple appropriation clause that authorizes a specific amount of funding for environmental health activities. It does not establish any process for consultation, public comment, advisory boards, or coordination with outside parties. It merely allocates money.
qwen_block.s: To carry out, except as otherwise provided for, sections 301 and 311 of the Act with respect to environmental health activities, $17,289,000.

It does not set up any consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body or right to sue involving parties outside the federal government. The mention of the underlying sections is just a funding reference, so it does not create participation here.
opus.s: To carry out, except as otherwise provided for, sections 301 and 311 of the Act with respect to environmental health activities, $17,289,000.
